title: sieve: RFC 5228 recursive-descent parser
description: Implement crates/sieve/src/parser.rs. Takes token stream from lexer, produces SieveScript (Vec<Command>) or ParseError. Grammar (RFC 5228 §8): sieve = *command; command = identifier arguments ('{' block '}' / ';'); arguments = *argument [test/test-list]; argument = string-list / number / tagged-arg; test = identifier arguments; block = *command. Recursive descent: parse_script, parse_command, parse_arguments, parse_test, parse_test_list, parse_block, parse_string_or_list. Require command: must only appear at top level (not nested), validate extension names are strings, return RequireAfterCommand if require appears after any non-require command. If command: parse condition test, then-block, optional elsif/else chains. Stop, Keep, Discard, FileInto, Reject, Redirect: parse as Actions. Unknown identifiers: raise UnknownCommand. Tests: parse RFC 5228 Appendix A.1 example script (from the RFC text), parse if/elsif/else, parse require, error on require-after-command, error on unclosed brace, error on missing semicolon.
